resources.string:
Calculator++ (Modernized & Privacy Edition)

 Original Creator & Author:
Sergey Solovyev (serso aka se.solovyev)
Email: se.solovyev@gmail.com
Original Project: github.com/serso/android-calculatorpp
Website: http://se.solovyev.org

 Modernized & Maintained by:
Naveen Kumar Yeluri
Repository: github.com/NaveenKumarYeluri/android-calculatorpp

 Privacy & Offline Guarantee:
• 100% Offline (No Internet permission, No network state)
• Zero Tracking (Firebase Analytics completely removed)
• Zero Ads & Zero Billing SDKs

 Modern Features:
• Material UI Themes: White, Black, Grey, and True Black (AMOLED)
• Floating On-Screen Calculator with resize & drag support
• Quick Settings Tile & Launcher App Shortcuts
• Symbolic calculations & graphing engine
• Unit converter & numeral bases (Hex, Dec, Oct, Bin)

 Distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

 Open Source Libraries:
• Simple (XML serialization)
• JSCL (Symbolic Computation)
• Material Components & Android Jetpack
